_comment: Persistent, human-reviewed waivers for semantic-audit.mjs. Key by item key (misplaced/homeless/faith/ambiguous) or by the two item keys SORTED and joined with '|' (dup). Value: true (waive all), or { kinds?, hash?, reason? }. With `hash` (content sha1[:12]) a changed item re-flags. See docs/CONTENT-QUALITY.md.

es/supermarket/arroz.reason: grocery item — correctly in supermarket; model pulls to kitchen via the cooking definition

es/airport/destination.reason: flight destination — a travel term, correctly in airport

es/transportation/barco.reason: FALSE positive — a boat IS transport; model pulls to naturaleza via 'agua'

es/naturaleza/energia.reason: energy (natural/renewable) — correctly in naturaleza; model pulls to gym via 'movimiento/calor'

es/kitchen/knead.reason: FALSE positive — kneading dough is cooking; model pulls to gym via 'trabajar con firmeza/manos'

es/restaurant/gastronomy.reason: FALSE positive — gastronomy is dining/food, correctly in restaurant; model pulls to museums via 'arte/cultura'

en/accountability/overhead.reason: FALSE positive — business operating cost, correctly in accountability

es/naturaleza/cielo.reason: FALSE positive — the sky is nature, correctly in naturaleza

en/movies/soundtrack.reason: a film's music — a movies term, kept in movies

es/movies/soundtrack.reason: banda sonora — término de cine, se queda en movies

es/music/venue.reason: concert venue — a music term, kept in music

en/music/venue.reason: concert venue — a music term, kept in music

es/movies/streaming.reason: media consumption — kept in movies (watching content)

en-es/health_i_have_a_cold|en-es/weather.reason: FALSE positive — different meanings (illness 'estoy resfriada' vs temperature 'tengo frío'); model conflates 'cold'

es-en/health_i_have_a_cold|es-en/weather.reason: FALSE positive — different meanings (illness vs temperature)

en-es/personal_info_how_old_are_you|en-e.reason: legitimate synonyms teaching DIFFERENT vocabulary (años vs edad); both natural and useful
